## Behavior / approved spec

Describe visible Android/iOS behavior, the concrete spec requirement, active ExecPlan and the platforms touched.

## Data, access and privacy

State whether the change touches live sources, RP observations, screenshot import, iOS App Group entitlements, provider credentials or third-party assets. Explain source/provenance and fallback semantics. Pack/heirloom tracker is explicitly out of scope.

## Validation

Record exact common/Android/iOS commands and results, devices/simulators tested, and honest BLOCKED cases (especially macOS/Xcode availability). Do not claim a test ran if it did not.

## Documentation

Link any updated ADR, requirements, platform specs, version plan, security/privacy and release gates.
